name: Clinic Consent
oneLiner: Consent capture, acknowledgements, and sensitive-data handling.

operations.name: grantConsent
operations.description: Grant consent for a specific purpose. Idempotent: re-granting active consent is a no-op.

operations.name: revokeConsent
operations.description: Revoke consent for a specific purpose.

operations.name: hasActiveConsent
operations.description: Check whether a patient has active consent for a purpose. Audited as a check.
